protocol.name: train-map LiDAR surface patches with pretrained PixLoc multi-scale direct feature alignment
protocol.dataset_note: 32 validation frames from one repeatedly used development route; not an independent test sequence
protocol.baseline: same frozen SC2-PCR plus two-stage full-pool-refinement initial pose; compared against frozen peak_then_pose
protocol.candidate_policy: one direct shared pose per frame; insufficient visual support minimizes the single LiDAR-prior objective
protocol.map_observations: all supported observations from the train-only visual map; no RoMa peak or correspondence offsets used by the candidate
protocol.feature_model: official PixLoc MegaDepth VGG19 U-Net; encoder, decoder and uncertainty frozen; original multi-scale feature adaptation layers fine-tuned on train split only
protocol.feature_loss: normalized learned feature residual, PixLoc scaled Barron alpha=0 c=0.1 form and frozen uncertainty maps
protocol.patch_support: local PCA plane from 16 nearest train-map LiDAR points, 3x3 reference pixels at offsets -4/0/4, convex-hull support, nearest-map support <=0.25 m, maximum sample radius <=0.5 m
protocol.map_selection: one reference view per map point, selected by baseline-viewpoint angular similarity; z-buffered and spatially sampled to one patch per 18x13 image grid cell per query camera
protocol.surface_patch_weighting: each surface patch normalized by its currently valid sample count
protocol.lidar_prior: single existing frame-level quadratic pose prior included once
protocol.reference_pose_source: training-split LiDAR GT used only to lift known train-map reference pixels onto the map surface
